subject: SIMPLE-NN v2.0.0 energy/force/struct_weight loss behavior (verified from source + independent agent)

energy_loss_E_loss_type_1.formula: e_loss[s] = MSE(E_pred[s]/n_atoms[s], E_target[s]/n_atoms[s]); w_e_loss = mean_s(e_loss[s] * struct_weight[s])
energy_loss_E_loss_type_1.meaning: PER-ATOM energy error, one value per structure; struct_weight enters PER STRUCTURE before the batch mean
energy_loss_E_loss_type_1.size_behavior: already size-normalized (per-atom); energy contribution of structure s ∝ struct_weight[s]

force_loss_F_loss_type_1.formula: f_loss = MSE(F_pred, F_target) elementwise over (atom,xyz); per structure s its block scaled by struct_weight[s]; w_f_loss = mean over ALL force components in batch
force_loss_F_loss_type_1.meaning: ATOM-WEIGHTED: structure s force contribution ∝ struct_weight[s] * N_atoms[s]; denominator = total force components in batch
force_loss_F_loss_type_1.consequence: to equalize per-structure force contribution regardless of size => struct_weight[s] ∝ 1 / N_atoms[s]

struct_weight_provisioning.granularity: PER TAG (data_generator.py: `[tag : weight]` in str_list; default 1.0; first value wins on tag collision)
struct_weight_provisioning.per_structure_weights: give each structure its own unique tag -> distinct weight; uses stock str_list parsing; NO SIMPLE-NN core modification

applied_when: weighted = False if valid else True (run.py:287) -> struct_weight affects TRAINING ONLY; validation metrics are unweighted (clean fidelity)

coefficients.note: total = 1.0*e_loss + 0.1*f_loss; struct_weight shared by both e and f

independent_verification: general-purpose agent adversarially re-read the source and CONFIRMED (a) MSELoss reduction none, (b) energy per-atom/per-structure, (c) force atom-weighted, (d) 1/N_atoms equalization algebra, (e) train-only weighting; and confirmed per-tag provisioning needs unique tags with no core mod
implication_for_PC002_ensemble: 112 production cells (~2900 atoms) = 32.1% of atoms => 32.1% of unweighted force training from only 7 lineages; struct_weight is the lever to correct this (see pc003_current_weighting_decision.json)
